Jackson Hospital

344 Beds
Acute Care Hospitals
MONTGOMERY, AL
Independent
Current ERP: MEDITECH
Version: NA
A job posting for a position at Jackson Hospital in Montgomery, AL explicitly states that their EMR system is MediTech.

Based on the search results, here’s what I found regarding Jackson Hospital in Montgomery, AL and their IT systems:

  • Electronic Health Records (EHR): In 2011, Jackson Hospital was recognized as a leader in EHR adoption, implementing a comprehensive system starting in 2005 ([2]). They were also working towards meeting “meaningful use” guidelines for EHR incentive programs ([2]).

  • Allscripts EHR: In 2021, Jackson Hospital used Allscripts EHR ([3]).

  • McKesson: Prior to using Allscripts EHR, Jackson Hospital used Quadramed Affinity for registration for eight years, but subsequently converted to McKesson Star. They also installed McKesson Horizon Patient Folders and several McKesson applications as part of their overall Information System ([6]).

  • MediTech: A job posting mentions that Jackson Hospital’s EMR system is MediTech ([5]).

    • The job posting for “Physician Extender - Cardiology” at Jackson Hospital in Montgomery, AL explicitly states: “EMR System: MediTech” ([5]).

  • MEDITECH as an option for Healthcare systems: Healthcare IT Leaders, an IT staffing company, lists MEDITECH as one of the solutions they provide consultants for ([9]).

  • MediSYS: MediSYS lists Jackson Hospital as one of the hospitals with which they have EHR interoperability ([4]).

  • Patient Engagement and Revenue Cycle: In 2021, Jackson Hospital implemented a digital patient engagement strategy with Firstsource to improve patient communication and financial outcomes, using data from their Allscripts EHR ([3]).

  • Medline Partnership: Jackson Hospital has a long-standing relationship with Medline, using them as their medical-surgical prime vendor for over nine years. In 2024, they expanded the partnership to include environmental services products ([10], [25]).

  • Financial Restructuring: In February 2025, Jackson Investment Group provided a loan to Jackson Hospital & Clinic to enable it to remain open during Chapter 11 bankruptcy and reorganization proceedings ([7], [12]).

  • IT Support Needs: Jackson Hospital sought assistance in analyzing their MPI data for duplicates and reconciling them prior to moving forward with additional McKesson applications ([6]).

Summary of Findings:

While there’s evidence that Jackson Hospital used McKesson and Allscripts, the most direct evidence for MEDITECH is the job posting that states “EMR System: MediTech” ([5]). There is no mention of MEDITECH ERP.

DCH Health System, which includes Fayette Medical Center, implemented MEDITECH Expanse EHR across its facilities, going live in May 2021, as confirmed by multiple sources. Fayette Medical Center, part of DCH Health System, is confirmed to utilize MEDITECH Expanse for their Electronic Health Record (EHR) system, as indicated by a news release and multiple job postings.

Based on the search results, here’s what I found regarding Fayette Medical Center and MEDITECH:

  • DCH Health System uses MEDITECH Expanse: DCH Health System, which includes Fayette Medical Center, implemented MEDITECH Expanse EHR across its hospitals and clinics. This was announced in September 2018 and went live in May 2021.
  • MEDITECH Expanse is an EHR: MEDITECH Expanse is described as a web-based, mobile Enterprise Health Record (EHR) system.
  • Fayette Medical Center is part of DCH Health System: Several sources confirm that Fayette Medical Center is part of the DCH Health System, along with DCH Regional Medical Center and Northport Medical Center.
  • DCH Health System Achieves Level 8 Most Wired: In June 2022, it was announced that DCH Health System achieved Level 8 Most Wired status after going live with MEDITECH Expanse across three hospitals.
  • MEDITECH and Google Health Collaboration: DCH Health System is an early adopter of the MEDITECH and Google Health collaboration to embed Google Health search and summarization capabilities within MEDITECH’s Expanse EHR clinical workflow (November 2022).
  • NetDelivery Interfaces with Meditech: DCH Regional Medical Center uses NetDelivery, which interfaces with Meditech to capture reports and patient EMRs.

While these results confirm that DCH Health System, including Fayette Medical Center, utilizes MEDITECH Expanse as its EHR system, I didn’t find specific information about whether Fayette Medical Center utilizes MEDITECH for ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning). Many articles focus on the EHR implementation of Meditech Expanse.

Based on my research, here’s what I found regarding Fayette Medical Center and its use of MEDITECH:

  • MEDITECH EMR: Fayette Medical Center, as part of DCH Health System, utilizes MEDITECH Expanse as their Electronic Health Record (EHR) system. A news release from 2020-08-13, discusses the launch of MEDITECH Expanse at DCH, expecting it to offer clinical features for improved patient care.

  • Job Postings: Mentions of MEDITECH Expanse appear in job postings associated with DCH Health System, including positions at Fayette Medical Center. For example, a Physician - DCH Fayette Medical Center- Emergency Medicine posting lists “Meditech Expanse Requirements.”

  • DCH Health System Implementation: The DCH Health System has been implementing MEDITECH Expanse across its facilities.

While the search results confirm the use of MEDITECH Expanse as the EMR, there’s no specific mention of MEDITECH being used as the ERP system in the search results. The focus is on its EHR capabilities.
